commit_message: Complete ADR0125 VFX playback and responsive authoring
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the remaining ADR 0125 first-release VFX lifecycle and Project Rust control gap on current main, and moves VFX Builder compilation plus project VFX document reads/writes off the egui thread. The existing versioned VFX document/compiler, deterministic CPU VfxInstance runtime, simple ParticleEmitter adapter, renderer integration, and production VfxPlayer preview path remain shared rather than creating a second VFX runtime.

## Validation

Run normal Windows validation and the deterministic VFX Builder visual fixture. Visually verify VFX Builder emitter/module authoring, curve/gradient UI, preview controls, rendered preview, and Scene View integration.
